defs.def: a written account of sth that is kept so that it can be looked at and used in the future 记录；记载

ex.s: In the race to document the species on Earth before they go extinct, researchers and citizen scientists have collected billions of records.
ex.t: 在赶在物种灭绝前记录地球物种的竞赛中，研究人员和公民科学家已收集了数十亿条记录。

ex.s: Using a global dataset of 1.9 billion records of plants, insects, birds, and animals, Daru and his team tested how well these data represent actual global biodiversity patterns.
ex.t: 达鲁和他的团队利用包含19亿条植物、昆虫、鸟类和动物记录的全球数据集，检验了这些数据对全球生物多样性真实模式的代表性如何。

ex.s: Their study revealed that the large number of observation-only records did not lead to better global coverage.
ex.t: 他们的研究表明，大量仅基于观察的记录并没有带来更好的全球覆盖。

ex.s: Hire experts to check the records.
ex.t: 聘请专家核查记录。

ex.s: From the English side, we have scientific reports and the captain’s record of that terrible day.
ex.t: 从英方那里，我们有科学报告和船长对那可怕一天的记录。

ex.s: His record was one-sided.
ex.t: 他的记录是片面的。

ex.s: It’s a record of a historic event.
ex.t: 它是对一个历史事件的记录。

ex.s: After you’ve tried a new method for a week, take a look at your record.
ex.t: 试用新方法一周后，看看你的记录。

ex.s: Since he first reunited Corrado’s medal, Zac says his record is now 5 for 5.
ex.t: 自从他第一次让科拉多的勋章团聚以来，扎克说他的记录现在是5次成功5次。

ex.s: Moreover, the USA has a track record of successfully accepting immigrants.
ex.t: 此外，美国有成功接受移民的历史记录。

ex.s: “I knew if I recorded all of my parents’ recipes, it would be a great gift that I could give my family and the next generation.” she says.
ex.t: “我知道如果我把父母所有的食谱都记录下来，那将是一份我可以送给家人和下一代的很好的礼物，”她说。

ex.s: Students record short entries after each partner meeting noting the language skills practised and the topics discussed.
ex.t: 学生在每次结对见面后记录简短的日志，注明练习的语言技能和讨论的话题。

ex.s: These scenes may have been painted hundreds of years ago, but they record moments we can all relate to.
ex.t: 这些场景也许是数百年前画下的，但它们记录了我们每个人都能感同身受的时刻。

ex.s: Why did Ms Young want to record her parents’ recipes?(no more than 15 words)
ex.t: 为什么Young女士想记录她父母的食谱？（不超过15个词）

ex.s: Make sure you fill in the attendance sheet at each session to record your attendance.
ex.t: 确保每次课程都填写考勤表以记录出勤情况。

ex.s: Record _____ to do the activities.
ex.t: 记录 _____ 来做活动。

ex.s: It has a digital display that records your steps, speed and distance, as well as monitoring your heart rate and calories burnt.
ex.t: 它有一个数字显示屏，记录你的步数、速度和距离，同时监测你的心率和消耗的卡路里。

ex.s: In 1960, Chile suffered the strongest 4______ to be recorded in the 20th century.
ex.t: 1960年，智利遭受了20世纪有记录以来最强的______。

defs.def: a thin round piece of plastic on which music, etc. is recorded 唱片

ex.s: It happened that the plant downtown needed eight kids for __43__ help during our spring break, for which I had no __44__ beyond listening to my favorite records.
ex.t: 碰巧市中心那家植物园在春假期间需要八个孩子做____43____帮手，而除了听我最喜欢的唱片之外，我对此毫无____44____。

ex.s: I recorded myself with confidence.
ex.t: 我自信地录下了自己。

defs.def: a piece or collection of music released as a record, or on CD, the Internet, etc. 唱片；专辑
the best result or the highest or lowest level that has ever been reached, especially in sport （尤指体育运动中最高或最低的）纪录
the facts that are known about sb/sth's past behaviour, character, achievements, etc. （有关过去的）事实；记录；经历；功过

ex.s: What do we know about the records of species collected now?
ex.t: 关于目前收集的物种记录，我们了解到什么？

ex.s: But now is the time to set the record straight, which starts with questioning the idea that all social comparison is unhealthy.
ex.t: 但现在是澄清事实的时候了，首先要质疑所有社会比较都不健康这一观念。

ex.s: Though they are useful for detecting shifts in the number and variety of species in an area, a new Stanford study has found that this type of record is not perfect.
ex.t: 尽管它们有助于探测一个地区物种数量和种类的变化，但斯坦福大学的一项新研究发现，这类记录并不完美。

ex.s: This track record makes ALife a ripe target for criticism, such as declarations of the field’s doubtful scientific value.
ex.t: 这使得ALife成为批评的有力目标，例如对该领域科学价值的质疑。

ex.s: Present past academic records to UCLA.
ex.t: 向UCLA提交过往学业记录。

ex.s: Today, most records of biodiversity are often in the form of photos, videos, and other digital records.
ex.t: 如今，大多数生物多样性记录往往以照片、视频和其他数字记录的形式存在。

ex.s: This makes sense because the people who get observational biodiversity data on mobile devices are often citizen scientists recording their encounters with species in areas nearby.
ex.t: 这是有道理的，因为通过移动设备获取生物多样性观察数据的人，往往是记录自己在附近地区偶遇物种的公民科学家。

ex.s: Since I began thinking about this project in August 2011, the issue of sea-level rise and the need to place it historically have only become more urgent: between then and the end of 2022 the global sea rose by almost 5 centimeters, about half of the overall rise recorded by satellites since 1993.
ex.t: 自从2011年8月我开始思考这个项目以来，海平面上升问题以及将其置于历史背景中考察的必要性变得愈发紧迫：从那时到2022年底，全球海平面上升了近5厘米，约为卫星自1993年以来记录的总升幅的一半。

ex.s: The English youngster noticed that pollution levels are around two-thirds higher close to the ground than they are in the air at the height where they are recorded by the agency.
ex.t: 这位英国少年注意到，靠近地面的污染水平比该机构记录高度的空气中的污染水平高出约三分之二。

ex.s: As a photographer, I have spent the last two years ___48___  (record) everything I discovered.
ex.t: 作为一名摄影师，过去两年我一直在___48___（record）记录我所发现的一切。

ex.s: People have been working together to record its migration and make sure that there are enough plants for it to feed on.
ex.t: 人们一直在合作记录它的迁徙，并确保有足够的植物供它觅食。

ex.s: Why did the author feel strange about herself after listening to the recording? (no more than 10 words)
ex.t: 作者在听了录音后为什么对自己感觉奇怪？（不超过10个词）

ex.s: The teacher told us to record ourselves speaking about a holiday.
ex.t: 老师让我们录下自己谈论假期的内容。

ex.s: In the past, sound engineers worked in the back rooms of recording studios, but many of today's sound professionals are sharing their knowledge and experience with professionals in other fields to create new products based on the phenomenon we call sound.
ex.t: 过去，音响工程师在录音室的后台工作，但如今许多声音专业人士正在与其他领域的专业人士分享他们的知识和经验，以基于我们称之为声音的现象创造新产品。

defs.def: the fact of having committed crimes in the past 前科；犯罪记录
（希望载入正式记录）（仅）供记录

ex.s: If you forget to officially drop that course, a “F” (Fail) grade will be registered on your record at the end of the term.
ex.t: 如果你忘记正式退课，期末时你的记录上会登记一个“F”（不及格）成绩。

ex.s: If, at a later date, you wish to apply for a job or graduate school where an official copy of your UCLA record is required, it will be to your advantage to provide an impressive academic record.
ex.t: 如果日后你想申请工作或研究生院，需要提供一份UCLA正式成绩单，那么提供一份令人印象深刻的学业记录将对你有好处。

defs.def: to keep a permanent account of facts or events by writing them down, filming them, storing them in a computer, etc. 记录；记载

ex.s: It will also give them a handy record to refer back to.
ex.t: 这还会给他们一份方便查阅的记录。

ex.s: Keep a record and evaluate it weekly.
ex.t: 做记录并每周评估一次。

ex.s: take pollutant readings            B. record pollutant levels
ex.t: 从巴吉的数据中我们可以了解到什么？（    ）

ex.s: To keep records of her progress.
ex.t: 为了记录自己的进展。

ex.s: He established an office to keep records of the children, and then returned to Britain to find temporary homes for them.
ex.t: 他设立了一个办公室来记录这些孩子的情况，然后返回英国为他们寻找临时住所。

defs.def: to make a copy of music, a film/movie, etc. by storing it on tape or a disc so that you can listen to or watch it again 录制；录（音）；录（像）

ex.s: My immediate reaction was to assume I was listening to someone else's recording.
ex.t: 我的第一反应是我以为自己在听别人录的录音。

ex.s: I gave the homeowner a recording of the hunger screams of owl chicks.
ex.t: 我给了屋主一段猫头鹰雏鸟饥饿尖叫的录音。

ex.s: Examples and dialogues are recorded with real native speakers instead of automatic computers.
ex.t: 例句和对话由真正的母语者录制，而非自动计算机。

ex.s: To record popular songs    B.
ex.t: 录制流行歌曲 B.

defs.def: to perform music so that it can be copied onto and kept on tape 演奏音乐供录制；灌（唱片）
to make an official or legal statement about sth 发表正式（或法律方面的）声明；申明
to show a particular measurement or amount 标明；显示

ex.s: Baggy has become the first dog in the UK—and potentially the world—to join the fight against air pollution by recording pollutant levels near the ground.
ex.t: 它的监测器显示，越接近地面，空气污染程度越高，这突显了一个令人担忧的问题：婴儿和幼儿患肺部疾病的风险可能更高。
